summary: Frontend testing completed for two features: (1) Bug fix in Caja - 'Reabrir Caja del Día' button for SuperAdmin when caja is closed, and (2) Individual print icons for each receta type in Evaluación Oftalmológica. Both features work correctly end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: EvaluacionOftalmologica.js is 1832 lines - consider splitting into smaller modules (print modals could be extracted to separate components).
Caja.js is 2439 lines - candidate for modularization by concern (movimientos, cierres, apertura, etc.).
Minor: The onPrint handler uses <span onClick> instead of a proper <button> - could impact accessibility. Consider using a <button type='button'> with aria-label.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing patient 'Juan Pérez Morales' (EXP-202604-0002).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both features verified working: (1) When caja del día is Cerrada, SuperAdmin sees yellow 'Reabrir Caja del Día' button [data-testid=btn-reabrir-caja]. Clicking it reopens the caja - state changes to 'Abierta' and Nuevo Movimiento + Cerrar Caja buttons appear. (2) In Evaluación Oftalmológica after selecting a patient, each of the 3 receta sections (Medicamentos, Anteojos, Lentes de Contacto) has a Printer icon (title='Imprimir receta') in the CollapsibleSection header that opens a dedicated print modal with the correct RECETA heading and calls window.print(). All 3 verified by intercepting window.print (3/3 calls detected).
rca of the issue: N/A - both features work as intended.
